craft_evidence.owned: NONE stated: no brand page claims an owned mill, dye house or factory; the legal seller is a company named 株式会社岸屋 (Kishiya Co.) at the Kojima address, but nothing says it makes the goods
craft_evidence.makers: Feed tags only (product tags on omotodenim.jp/products.json): factory-tochigi on the 9200 belt, factory-mie on the 5180 shirt; no factory named in page text. Belt text: artisan with over 30 years in Kurashiki; 5180 sewn by an unnamed Okayama dress-shirt workshop
craft_evidence.mills: SHINYA MILL: named only as a product tag on the two 0815 Charcoal Overdyed listings (not in page text); looms named by type only (1950s Sakamoto-style shuttle loom; Toyoda looms on slub-nep; Hirano-style looms on 5180); Matsusaka (Mie) for 5180
craft_evidence.madein: 0 of 11 product pages read state a country of manufacture; Okayama named on 5180 shirt and monozukuri page, Sanbi region on denim pages; press (denimhunters) says cut and sewn in Japan
craft_evidence.heritage: Vague on the brand site: founder Kishimoto "20+ years" in fabric development, no founding year or place on About page; retailer/press say launched 2025 by Hiroki Kishimoto (ex Collect Mill, Japan Blue)
craft_evidence.process: Yes, specific: fibre blend and staple lengths (Memphis 27.8mm / Zimbabwe 28.6mm, or Texas), rope dyeing in 100% pure indigo with white core, unsanforized, not singed/twisted, one-wash, loom types, lot numbers
craft_evidence.reasoning: Process is documented unusually well for a one-year-old label (fibre, staple length, rope dye, loom type), but the brand site names no mill, no factory and no maker, states no country of manufacture on the product pages read, owns no stated facility, and gives no founding date or place. That is between a 2 (little checkable beyond region) and a 3 (named makers/mills); proposed 2, rising to 3 if Sebastian counts loom type and the Okayama/Sanbi region as named making. Confidence medium-low. Second pass: the shop feed tags name SHINYA MILL (2 listings), factory-tochigi and factory-mie; tags are feed metadata, not page text, so 2 stands and 3 is arguable.

ownership.owner: 株式会社岸屋 (Kishiya Co., Ltd.), 1-10-17 Ajino, Kojima, Kurashiki, Okayama 711-0913; representative 岸本裕樹 (brand legal notice). Stand-alone brand: not a label of Collect Mill or Okayama Denim (Okayama Denim is a listed stockist).
